intro: "Remember That I Love You" begins with a torn, stained parchment discovered among the undead-stalked graves in the Ruins of Lordaeron. The letter tells the tragic tale of a lost child belonging to the Heartweaver family. Seeking answers requires carrying this fragile relic south to the orphanage in Stormwind City.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A torn and stained bundle of parchment has barely survived the undead trodden grounds of the graveyard. It mentions a missing child of the Heartweaver family. Perhaps the orphan matron in Stormwind City will know more.
